summary: Variables and returned values can now be tagged as deprecated, producing a runtime warning with suggested alternatives when they are accessed, such as play_hosts suggesting ansible_play_batch.
questions: Why do I get a deprecation warning when using play_hosts?
What should I use instead of play_hosts?
Can modules mark return values as deprecated?

answer_card.title: Deprecation warnings when values are accessed
answer_card.answer_md:
Most ansible-core variables and values can now be tagged as deprecated. Plugins and modules can tag parts of their return values with a description and help text, and a runtime warning appears when a playbook or template **accesses** that value.

Example: accessing the deprecated `play_hosts` magic variable warns you to use `ansible_play_batch` instead.
